DESCRIPTION:
Create a feat/fix/refactor/etc branch from main, optionally naming it from a 
Jira issue

USAGE:
    doit-bc git new-branch [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    doit-bc git new-branch --type feat --jira DOIT-123
    doit-bc git new-branch --type fix --description correct rounding on invoice 
totals

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help           Prints help information                                
        --type           Conventional commit type: feat, fix, refactor, docs,   
                         chore, test, build, ci, perf, style. Prompted if       
                         omitted                                                
        --jira           Jira issue key, e.g. DOIT-123. If set and Jira is      
                         configured, the title is pulled automatically          
    -d, --description    Short description, used if no Jira key is given (or    
                         Jira lookup is skipped)                                
    -b, --base           Branch to create the new branch from. Defaults to      
                         'main'
